d: Robert Mitchum stars in an unforgettable role as a psychopathic preacher in relentless pursuit of two children who have their dead father's stolen fortune hidden in a doll.  Shelley Winters co-stars.
Dr. Paul Carruthers is cheated by his employers after developing a new aftershave lotion, so he seeks revenge by using a giant killer bat to kill anyone wearing the lotion.
A mad scientist trying to cure polio must obtain human spinal fluid, and resorts to nefarious means by wearing an ape suit to procure victims for his experiment without being detected.

A country mansion full of guests soon becomes the playground of a killer after a hidden stash of embezzled money.  The guests begin to disappear one by one as The Bat's identity is closer to being discovered.

A fanatical Egyptologist purchases a stolen jewel, believing in its power to restore the dead.  The stone is pursued by a zealot determined to return it to the tomb from which it was stolen before it can release its worst power.

En bergsby hemsöks av en vålnad i form av en liten mordisk flicka, vilket får en rättsläkare och en medicinstuderande att försöka avslöja hennes hemligheter medan en häxa använder sina konster för att skydda byborna.
